detail.longDescription: Anthropic: > We’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent. > It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf. The Matrix (1999): > Agent Smith: > "Which is why the Matrix was redesigned to this: the peak of your civilization. I say your civilization, because as soon as we started thinking for you it really became our civilization, which is of course what this is all about."
